content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the Mizoram University Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. content_sections.heading: Mizoram University Senior Project Associate Vacancy Details 2026
Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Project Associate: Master's degree (minimum 55% marks or equivalent CGPA) in relevant branch of Biological Sciences along with 04 years (Post PG) R & D experience or PhD in relevant branch of Biological Sciences.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 40 years Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: Mizoram University Senior Project Associate Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 17-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Mizoram University Senior Project Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 17th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree with a minimum of 55% marks in a relevant branch of Biological Sciences, along with 4 years of post-PG R&D experience or a PhD.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for this post is 40 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 42,000 per month plus HRA (9%).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Mizoram University Senior Project Associate vacancy?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent via email to the official email address provided in the notification. Ensure all required documents are attached.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Senior Project Associate role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an online interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the Senior Project Associate position is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' description.

faq.question: Q10. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Senior Project Associate.
